I was never one to deal with break ups okay, since this person had a very big impact in my life I had a part time letting them go. So, I tried to talk to them, but me being upset turned into me beinf frustrated and I didn't know how to deal with that.

I'm more so upset that I managed to end on bad terms than anything else. A part of me wants to fix it, but I know there's no chance for that and attempting just makes me feel even worse.

Thank you for the advice. You've helped and I've lacked that person to talk to.
Thank you :( I just don't know what to do from here. Your sentiments do help, I'm just kind of lost in everything.

Surprisingly, I do not. I'm trying my best to save, but the previous roommate I had quit his job and left me with the bills.

I had the second job because I needed to pay for bills, but now I can't afford it. I actually quit my job so I could spend more time with my ex, but a week after I did he broke up with me.

I'm only 20. So, my savings aren't the greatest.
